name: system-notification-thread-entity-deleted
description: System default template for deleted Conversation V2 entities
templateBody:
@{{event.userName}} deleted a conversation {{#with (parseEntityLink entity.about) as |link|}}{{#if link.field}}about {{link.field}} {{/if}}{{/with}}for {{camelCaseToTitle entity.entityRef.type}} {{#if entity.entityRef.displayName}}{{entity.entityRef.displayName}}{{else}}{{entity.entityRef.fullyQualifiedName}}{{/if}}{{#if entity.message}}

🗑️ Deleted message:
{{{processMentions entity.message}}}
{{/if}}
